item.title: eSports Marvel Rivals Team Qualifies for State Playoffs
item.description: The Winter 2026 season marked a significant milestone for WHS Esports, highlighted by the successful introduction of Marvel Rivals into our competitive rotation. Student-athletes embraced the opportunity to compete with their favorite MCU characters while representing WHS against top programs across the state.
